  person_info1.info,
  COUNT(*)
FROM ((((((kind_type AS kind_type1 CROSS JOIN title AS title1) CROSS JOIN (cast_info AS cast_info1 CROSS JOIN movie_info AS movie_info1)) CROSS JOIN person_info AS person_info1) CROSS JOIN role_type AS role_type1) CROSS JOIN info_type AS info_type2) CROSS JOIN info_type AS info_type1) CROSS JOIN name AS name1
WHERE
  title1.id = cast_info1.movie_id
  AND title1.id = movie_info1.movie_id
  AND movie_info1.info_type_i
